motive.zhHans: 冢本和美解释说，保坂的桌子之所以放进储藏室，是为了在毕业时搬出来纪念保坂，并不是为了藏匿证据。最先赶到现场的校医新出编了一套善意的谎话，说保坂临终时说自己并无怨恨，为的是安慰三年级的学生。新出说事情办得很顺利，但他问 Jodie：Vermouth 真的是恶人吗——因为所有学生和老师对那位化装成他的 Vermouth 的亲切与体贴都只有称赞。
motive.en: Kazumi Tsukamoto explains that Hosaka's desk was put in the storage room so that it could be brought out for graduation in memory of Hosaka and was not to hide evidence. Araide, who was the first doctor on the scene, concocts a white lie about Hosaka's last words to say held no grudges when he died in order to soothe the third years. Araide says it went smoothly but asks Jodie if Vermouth was really an evil person because all the students and teachers had nothing but praise for the disguised Vermouth's kindness and compassion.

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借园子之口解开案件，指出犯人是 Kunishige Seko——死者保坂英明的挚友。Kunishige 透露，他在储藏室发现朋友的桌子上写着名字，便以为朋友是被欺凌、然后被杀害的。物部雅夫道出事情的真相：保坂是为了救他而死的——当时他抱着一件沉重的雕塑往后跌下楼梯，雕塑压在了保坂身上。冢本和美解释说，保坂的桌子之所以放进储藏室，是为了在毕业时搬出来纪念保坂，并不是为了藏匿证据。最先赶到现场的校医新出编了一套善意的谎话，说保坂临终时说自己并无怨恨，为的是安慰三年级的学生。案件结束后，新出接到 Jodie 的电话，询问他重返帝丹高中的情况。新出说事情办得很顺利，但他问 Jodie：Vermouth 真的是恶人吗——因为所有学生和老师对那位化装成他的 Vermouth 的亲切与体贴都只有称赞。Jodie 生气地吼道：「一个人要是能笑着杀人，她怎么可能善良！？」随后挂断了电话。
resolution.en: Conan, using Sonoko, solves the case and reveals the culprit was Kunishige Seko, a close friend to the dead student Hideaki Hosaka. Kunishige reveals that he found his friend's desk in the storage room with a name on it, thinking he was bullied and then murdered. Masao Monobe reveals the true story of events, Hosaka died saving him from falling backwards down the stairs while holding a heavy sculpture. The sculpture crushed Hosaka. Kazumi Tsukamoto explains that Hosaka's desk was put in the storage room so that it could be brought out for graduation in memory of Hosaka and was not to hide evidence. Dr. Araide, who was the first doctor on the scene, concocts a white lie about Hosaka's last words to say held no grudges when he died in order to soothe the third years. After the case, Dr. Araide receives a call from Jodie who is checking on his reintegration into Teitan High. Dr. Araide says it went smoothly but asks Jodie if Vermouth was really an evil person because all the students and teachers had nothing but praise for the disguised Vermouth's kindness and compassion. Jodie angrily hangs up on Araide after yelling, "How in the world can someone be kind if she kills people with a smile!?"
